notes.title: Launch Day and Beyond
notes.notes:
I want to express my heartfelt gratitude to everyone who has shown their support for "The Secrets of Hope" on Kickstarter and Steam. Our official launch has been nothing short of amazing, and the past 24 hours have been incredibly exciting. I've been thoroughly enjoying reading all the comments and watching playthroughs shared on social media.

I'm particularly grateful for the valuable feedback many of you have provided, which has sparked insightful discussions about how we can enhance the overall gaming experience. Your suggestions have not gone unnoticed.

In the days ahead, we are committed to diligently addressing the feedback and resolving any bugs that may arise. We will also be rolling out a series of hotfixes as necessary to ensure that "The Secrets of Hope" reaches its fullest potential and becomes the best game it can be.

I want to extend my sincerest thanks to each and every one of you for helping us achieve a successful launch for our first game. This journey has brought us closer to realizing our dream of creating games we're passionate about, and we couldn't have done it without your support.

With heartfelt appreciation,
Josh

notes.title: Upcoming Launch
notes.notes:
Greetings, everyone! Josh here,

I wanted to take a moment to share some exciting updates regarding The Secrets of Hope's development and its demo showcased during Steam Next Fest. The overwhelming support we received for the demo has been truly incredible, and I can't express my gratitude enough.

The demo offers just a glimpse of the captivating story and immersive experience that awaits you in The Secrets of Hope. The game's full release is scheduled for September 7th, 2023, exclusively on Steam.

We have deliberately chosen this release date to allow us to complete our ongoing Kickstarter Campaign successfully, which features some amazing rewards. Additionally, we want to finalize our marketing efforts and address a few minor development tasks. By doing so, we aim to ensure that the game's launch is nothing short of exceptional.

To foster a stronger connection with our community, we will be actively sharing more updates and crafting community-centric posts. I encourage all of you to join our Discord channel and follow us on all our social media platforms. We are eager to engage with you and build closer relationships within our community.

Thank you all for your continued support, and we eagerly anticipate the release of The Secrets of Hope.

[url=https://discord.gg/uBs47ZsCpm]Join The Discord[/url]

Best regards,
Josh
